notes: No general-format / syntax-skeleton figures occur on any page of this batch (page_workunit reported '0 with figure content'). Pages 1006-1009 are Annex A.4 optional-language-element lists; pages 1010-1017 are Annex B (normative), the user-defined-word character repertoire. The choice-indicator / bracket / ellipsis / underlining defect classes are therefore not applicable here. Every prose sentence, NOTE, list item, cross-reference number and hexadecimal code range was compared glyph by glyph against the rendered page; all ranges on pages 1011-1017 transcribe exactly. Two defect classes were found: (a) a repeated page-boundary defect in which the Unicode script-name label printed at the TOP of a page is instead appended to the LAST data line of the preceding page, and (b) a heading-level defect in which A.4.4 through A.4.11 are promoted to the same markdown level as their parent A.4 and as 'Annex A'/'Annex B'.
